rules: Contract-first: API contract must be created and approved in wiki/api-contracts/ BEFORE any backend implementation
RESTful naming: plural nouns for resources (/products, /orders, /invoices)
HTTP verbs: GET=read, POST=create, PATCH=partial update, DELETE=soft delete. PUT is not used
All list endpoints return: { data: T[], total: number, page: number, limit: number }
All success responses: HTTP 200 (get/list), 201 (create), 204 (delete, no body)
All error responses: { statusCode, message, errorCode, timestamp, path }
Error codes are namespaced: AUTH_001, PRODUCT_001, ORDER_001, etc.
Pagination params: ?page=1&limit=20. Default limit 20, max limit 100
All timestamps returned as ISO 8601 UTC strings
All monetary amounts returned as integers (VND, no decimals)
API versioning: /api/v1/* prefix for all routes
Content-Type must be application/json. Form data only for file uploads
